ns2:section.sectionText: Rally Point. The military offers individuals an opportunity to gain a wide variety of skills, tools, and opportunities. While some of the things learned in the military will help service members to succeed in an academic setting, others might serve as barriers that create obstacles throughout their educational journey. To address this, this course was designed to assist students to translate their military experience and apply components of their service backgrounds in order to succeed in school (as well as at home, work, and other parts of their lives). The course will allow students to: 1) determine where they've come from; 2) be clear about where they're going; and 3) identify obstacles that might get in the way. It is recommended (but not required) that students take AHS 199 VT-VT2: Veterans Leadership & Transition and Career Development for Military Connected Students. This class meets in room 1020 at the Center for Wounded Veterans, 908 W. Nevada St., Urbana.
